seoTitle: Reset a TradingView Chart to Its Default Layout
metaDescription: Learn how to clear a cluttered TradingView chart and return it to its default layout without losing your saved alerts or scripts.
intro: Over time, a TradingView chart can accumulate indicators, drawings, and settings that make it hard to see the bigger picture. This guide shows how to reset the chart back to its default layout while keeping any saved alerts or scripts unaffected.

steps.heading: Navigate to your chart
steps.body: Open the chart section on TradingView where you normally perform your analysis.

steps.heading: Right-click on the chart
steps.body: Right-click an open space within the chart area to bring up the menu with reset options.

steps.heading: Select reset chart
steps.body: Choose the reset chart option from the menu to begin restoring the default layout.

steps.heading: Confirm with reset chart view
steps.body: Click reset chart view to ensure all chart elements revert to their original default settings.

steps.heading: Review the cleaned-up chart
steps.body: The chart should refresh automatically, removing excess lines, boxes, or annotations that had built up over time.

steps.heading: Check that alerts and scripts remain
steps.body: Only the visual elements are reset — any saved alerts, scripts, or background settings stay intact.

faq.question: Will resetting my chart delete my alerts?
faq.answer: No, resetting only affects the visual layout — alerts, scripts, and other saved settings remain unaffected.

faq.question: How do I reset a TradingView chart to default?
faq.answer: Right-click the chart, select reset chart, then confirm with reset chart view to restore the default layout.

faq.question: Why would I reset my chart?
faq.answer: It's useful when a chart becomes cluttered with drawings, indicators, or settings, making it hard to focus on price action.

faq.question: Does this work for any trading style?
faq.answer: Yes, this reset process applies regardless of whether you're analyzing stocks, crypto, or forex.

faq.question: Can I undo a reset?
faq.answer: The reset restores default visual settings, so you'd need to manually re-add any drawings or custom settings you want back.
